create_eval_runner: create an EvalRunner with a dataloader, EvalUnit, callbacks, and max steps per epoch
run_eval_runner: run the EvalRunner to evaluate a model using TorchTNT's evaluate function with the configured dataloader
configure_eval_callbacks: configure an EvalRunner with a list of TorchTNT callbacks for evaluation hooks
set_max_steps: set the max steps per epoch on an EvalRunner to limit evaluation iterations
review_eval_runner_class: review the EvalRunner class that wraps TorchTNT evaluate with save and load state stubs
